packages.notes: Fix the menu bar needing two clicks every time: the bar and dock windows were focusable by default, so the window manager's click-to-focus consumed the first click just to focus the window and only the second click ever reached the menu. This also carries a bridge fix to the update system itself: a prior update tried to widen what files an update may change, but the OLD update-applier on your device couldn't accept the very file that would have widened it -- a chicken-and-egg bug that silently failed every install attempt. Fixed.
